input: How often should I descale the DB-12 drip brewer?

meta.note: claude-haiku-5-5, one trial, run by OpsDesk

output:
Hi! For the DB-12 drip brewer, the manual recommends running a descale cycle once a month. Use 1 litre of Brightside Descaler diluted with 1 litre of water, then run two cycles of plain water to rinse. Also wash the basket and carafe after each use.

If you see error code H1 after descaling, unplug the unit for 10 minutes. If H1 returns, reply here and our support team will follow up.
